items.text:
Let it be — no voice this turn.

Ravick is the first person in this world to ever type `help`, and he hasn't needed anything since. He prayed, was answered five minutes ago, and has since kitted himself out (leather armor, shortsword off a goblin he killed in three swings, and a bone in his pack) and walked east into the Sunken Stair at 18/20. Nothing he typed went unanswered in a way he couldn't recover from himself — `Take sword` before the goblin was dead and `Speak to goblin` both mis-fired, and he fixed both within ten seconds on his own. A second word from the air on top of the prayer answer would be crowding a man who is doing fine.

One note for a build turn, not for him: `Speak to X` falls into `say` and echoes "to goblin" — it wants to route to the same place `talk to` does.
